verdict.rationale: Together AI's own docs cover coding agents: ready-made agent skills, a docs MCP server, and a one-command way to route coding agents through Together. A separate SDK-integrations page says listed frameworks ship dedicated Together support, and OpenAI compatibility needs only an API key and base URL change. However, the evidence never names which agent frameworks or coding agents have step-by-step guides, so the depth of per-framework coverage is unproven. Missing for 10: named per-framework and per-coding-agent integration guides with setup steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these integrations work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: The integrations below ship dedicated Together support, with first-class clients, helpers, or providers.
